resources.description: A+–F token safety verdict by chain + address: grade, score, verdict prose, liquidity/holders/authority signals. Honest not-graded over fake confidence.
Token safety verdict by free-form query (address or name/ticker; resolves to the top-liquidity match).
Batch token safety verdicts — up to 10 items per call, flat price, results in input order.
Pre-graduation on-chain signals for a Solana mint: bundled-launch detection, curve-aware holder concentration, Token-2022 trap flags, authority state. The signal set most risk APIs are blind to.
Authority quick-check for a Solana mint: mint/freeze authority state, dangerous Token-2022 extensions, top-holder concentration.
Wallet portfolio audit: pass a Solana wallet address, get risk-graded verdicts for its largest token holdings (up to 10).
Recent trend-radar alerts as structured JSON: big dated movers with real market cap, exactly as posted to the public alert lanes.
Buy a 30-day HostDeFi API key (Agent plan: 5,000 calls, batch enabled) with one x402 payment — the key arrives in the paid response; no account, no signup.
Rug/collapse ledger: tokens that fell out of HostDeFi's liquidity/holder data gate, with peak stats and dates — the dated post-mortem record, newest exits first.
Graded token listing for one chain (solana, ethereum, base, arbitrum) from the dated weekly snapshot: score, grade, reasons, market structure — best-scored first.
The whole dated weekly safety-snapshot dataset in one call: every graded token across 4 chains plus authority states, holder concentration and the gate-exit ledger.
The full retained trend-radar alert history (up to 100 dated entries) in one call, newest first.

Token safety history: dated daily grade/score/liquidity rows for one token, oldest first — how the risk picture CHANGED, not just where it stands. Recording began 2026-08-16; an empty series is an uncharged 404.

Risk grade for one x402 seller or resource before you pay it: A–F from observable signals (spec fidelity of the 402 offer, price sanity, payTo presence, TLS, latency, reachability), dated crawl snapshot.
The full dated x402 provider-risk dataset in one call: every crawled seller and resource with grade, score and reasons.

Executable EVM swap: firm KyberSwap-routed quote plus a ready-to-sign transaction (gas figures, allowance target) for the taker to sign and broadcast from their own wallet — non-custodial, no key, no account. A 3% platform fee in the chain's native coin rides on top and is priced into the returned transaction.
EVM swap price preview: expected and minimum output for a pair/amount before committing to a firm quote — the cheap look-before-you-swap call.
